description:
Activate Catalyst Elemental by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Catalyst Elemental dies, Ashling and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Ashling trigger, creating a token copy of Catalyst Elemental with haste.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Catalyst Elemental from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Catalyst Elemental token by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Catalyst Elemental by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat.
